paper.title_en: Probing cosmological phase transitions with SKAO through nano-Hz gravitational-wave portal
paper.abstract_en: The recent evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background at nano-Hz frequencies from pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) provides a strong science case for exploring cosmological histories and phase transitions at the Square Kilometer Array Observatory (SKAO). The latter cosmological events are of primary interest for physics of the early Universe associated with out-of-equilibrium and relaxation phenomena in the vicinity the quantum chromodynamics (QCD) epoch as well as those originating from dark sectors or other phenomena beyond the Standard Model of particle physics. Such a novel GW portal provides a complimentary access to particle physics phenomena that have so far escaped detection at particle colliders, and also probes fundamental aspects of out-of-equilibrium dynamics beyond the perturbation theory and their cosmological implications. This chapter aims at elucidating most interesting physics cases, theoretical models and approaches, as well as cosmological scenarios that are of particular relevance for future GW measurements at SKAO. We elaborate on how such measurements can deepen our understanding of particle interactions and violent processes in the early Universe, and discuss possible competitive advantages and complementarity of SKAO in this research compared to other experiments.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文讨论了利用SKAO通过纳赫兹引力波探测宇宙学相变，与PTA主题高度相关，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 通过纳赫兹引力波门户用SKAO探测宇宙学相变
decision.abstract_zh: 最近来自脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）在纳赫兹频率下对随机引力波背景（GW）的观测证据，为在平方千米阵列天文台（SKAO）上探索宇宙学历史和相变提供了一个强有力的科学案例。后者宇宙学事件对于早期宇宙物理学至关重要，涉及量子色动力学（QCD）时代附近以及来自暗区或超越标准模型粒子物理的其他现象的非平衡和弛豫过程。这种新颖的引力波门户提供了对迄今在粒子对撞机上未能探测到的粒子物理现象的一种补充访问途径，并探测了超越微扰理论之外的超非平衡动力学的基本方面及其宇宙学影响。本章旨在阐明对SKAO未来引力波测量特别相关的最有趣的物理案例、理论模型和方法，以及宇宙学情景。我们详细阐述了这些测量如何加深我们对早期宇宙中粒子相互作用和剧烈过程的理解，并讨论了SKAO在这一研究中相对于其他实验可能具有的竞争优势和互补性。
